Name: Autowatering
Author: stellarashes
Description:
[b][color=#e06666][size=6]Auto Watering[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]This mod waters all your crops when they are planted and every day thereafter. It also works on [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Garden_Pot]Garden Pots[/url]﻿.
[*]This mod can also be configured to automatically apply [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Fertilizer]fertilizer[/url]﻿ to all your crops.
[/list]
[b][color=#e06666][size=4][u]Install[/u][/size][/color][/b][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][color=#e06666][size=4][u]Configuration[/u][/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/stellarashes/SDVMods/blob/master/Autowatering/Configuration/ModConfig.cs]Autowatering @ Github[/url]
[*]"Enabled": true,
[list][*]default = true
[*]true = mod on
[*]false = mod off
[/list][*]"ConfigReloadKey": "F5",
[list][*]Key bind to reload config.json when you make a change, no need to restart game.
[/list][*]"[url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Fertilizer]Fertilizer[/url]﻿": null
[list][*]default = null.
[*]0: Remove all fertilizer
[*]368: Basic Fertilizer
[*]369: Quality Fertilizer
[*]370: Basic Retaining Soil
[*]371: Quality Retaining Soil
[*]465: Speed-gro
[*]466: Deluxe Speed-Gro
[*]918 : Hyper Speed-Gro
[*]919 : Deluxe Fertilizer
[*]920 : Deluxe Retaining Soil
[/list][/list]
[b][color=#e06666][size=4][u]Other[/u][/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/stellarashes/SDVMods/tree/master/Autowatering]Source Code[/url]
[/list]
